title: Skin Care for Bangalore Weather: A Simple Routine for Every Season
ex: Cool mornings, strong sun, two monsoons, hard water and AC offices: how to adjust your skin care routine to Bengaluru weather through the year.
rt: Skin Care for Bangalore Weather: Season Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Bangalore weather: sunscreen on cool days, dry Dec–Feb skin, monsoon months, hard borewell water and AC offices, with a simple daily routine.
quick: Bangalore feels mild, so the two big needs are daily sunscreen, even on cool or cloudy days, and moisture in the dry December to February months. Use a gentle face wash, a light moisturiser and sunscreen in the morning, and a slightly richer night cream when the air turns dry.
facts: Bengaluru is about 900 m above sea level, so it rarely feels hot
Clear days can still tan skin on the commute
Air is driest from December to February
Hard borewell or tanker water can leave skin tight
